cd /code && Rscript -e 'd<-read.csv("/data/processed/d_contentAnalysis.csv", stringsAsFactors=FALSE); cat("citesReplication unique:", paste(unique(d$citesReplication), collapse=","), "
"); cat("counterArguments unique:", paste(unique(d$counterArguments), collapse=","), "
"); cat("methodsCounter unique:", paste(unique(d$methodsCounter), collapse=","), "
"); cat("sum methods on cited replication & counterarguments:", sum(as.logical(d$methodsCounter[d$citesReplication=="T" & d$counterArguments=="T"]), na.rm=TRUE), "
"); cat("sum methodsCounter overall:", sum(as.logical(d$methodsCounter), na.rm=TRUE), "
")'
